instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a two-story linear office building with three repeated structural bays on each floor. Internal partitions and stacked floor relationships should remain clear. The owner wants it standardized as a comparable office benchmark model: the first and second floors may use slightly different office load assumptions, the south and north facades should keep rhythmic window bands, and the floor adjacency relationships and long bar massing must not be broken. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
